description: This file defines the EnvHttpProxyAgent class and its associated options interface. It extends the Dispatcher class and interacts with Agent and ProxyAgent modules to provide an environment-aware HTTP proxy agent, mainly for configuring HTTP/HTTPS proxy settings via environment variables.

classes.name: EnvHttpProxyAgent
classes.description: A class extending Dispatcher to manage HTTP proxy settings based on environment variables, with customizable options.

methods.name: constructor (opts?: EnvHttpProxyAgent.Options) constructor
methods.description: Initializes an EnvHttpProxyAgent instance, optionally with custom options.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Handles dispatching requests with specified options and handler.
